subject.title: feat: paginate chat history with visible cursors

question: Should OpenClaw make the generation-aware visible-history cursor a permanent `chat.history` and published `session-transcript-runtime` contract, or keep the new capability narrower than the proposed parent-plus-child stack?
rationale: This draft adds user-facing Gateway protocol behavior and a published plugin SDK entrypoint; the correct long-term public boundary cannot be determined mechanically from the branch alone.

options.title: Approve the additive cursor contract
options.body: Review the parent and child as one public contract, preserve the legacy offset path, and require a rebase plus upgrade and real-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the SDK surface private
options.body: Retain only the Gateway and Control UI behavior if external plugins do not need the new published transcript-runtime entrypoint.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the stacked work until maintainers define the intended history-pagination and external-context-engine contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive cursor contract
recommendation.body: Review the parent and child as one public contract, preserve the legacy offset path, and require a rebase plus upgrade and real-runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main feature owner could be verified from the available history material; Gateway protocol and Control UI owners should jointly make the boundary decision.
